stories.title: Speed-to-Value Acceleration
stories.summary: Users reaching Time-to-First-Value within <12 hours convert at 45.7%, compared to only 23.6% for users taking >72 hours.
stories.action: Trigger automated onboarding tooltips and video tours within 2 hours of signup to drive immediate first feature execution.

stories.title: Power Feature Activation (Automation & Integrations)
stories.summary: Trial users activating power features (Team Invite, Integrations, Automation Rules) reach 40.4% conversion vs 31.4% for single-feature users.
stories.action: Prompt free-trial users with an 'Invite Teammate' pop-up on day 2 and highlight API/Integrations templates.

stories.title: High-Engagement Archetype Velocity
stories.summary: High Engagement segment users convert at 45.4% vs 22.5% for Low Engagement accounts.
stories.action: Prioritize Sales SDR outreach to trial users scoring above 70+ in Conversion Propensity Score within their first 5 days.

stories.title: Mid-Trial Churn Bottleneck (Days 4–8)
stories.summary: Over 80% of un-converted users experience flatlining activity between day 4 and 8. Negative engagement slope correlates with 70.8% non-conversion.
stories.action: Send an automated re-engagement email sequence featuring custom alert templates when user activity pauses for >48 hours.
